name: omp-dispatch
description: Dispatch delivery for Oh My Pi: tickets move along a configurable workflow state machine, with durable local protocol state, isolated seats, source-confirmed effects, and native scheduling.

workflowFile.description: Workflow file path, relative to the coordinator working directory

dataDir.description: Directory for agenda state, repository caches, seat worktrees and sessions, relative to the coordinator working directory; unset means <agentDir>/omp-dispatch; read when the coordinator starts

recomputeIntervalSeconds.description: Seconds between agenda recomputes, a whole number from 1 to 2147483; read when the coordinator starts

pmConfigDir.description: PM configuration repository root, relative to the coordinator working directory; empty leaves PM integration off; read when the coordinator starts

githubTrigger.description: GitHub App trigger: link starts a coordinator once an issue carries a valid launcher link; label also requires a label from githubTriggerLabels

githubTriggerLabels.description: Comma-separated labels for the label trigger; empty means any label

githubTriggerAssociations.description: Comma-separated issue author associations allowed to start a coordinator through the GitHub App

webhookHost.description: Host the GitHub App webhook listener binds; read when the launcher starts

webhookPort.description: Port the GitHub App webhook listener binds; read when the launcher starts

configCheckHost.description: Host the PM configuration check listener binds (POST /pm-config/check); read when the launcher starts

configCheckPort.description: Port the PM configuration check listener binds; must differ from the link port 47591 and webhookPort; read when the launcher starts
